keyEvents.text: Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Pablo Maffeo (Valencia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Valencia 0, Real Madrid 1. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Goal! Valencia 0, Real Madrid 2. Arda Güler (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Umar Sadiq (Valencia).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Andrii Lunin (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Valencia 0, Real Madrid 2.
